types.name: IOModule

fields.name: updatingEnabled
fields.comment: high: EnableUpdating 51710 CMP [ESI],BL / stores BL; Release 51750 tests and clears; Update 516d8 CMP byte [ESI],0 gates everything; GetIOModule zeroes byte

fields.name: resendAll
fields.comment: high: SendGameMessages 512f7 MOV AL,[EBX+1] bypasses the unchanged-value filter; Initialize 51097 and UpdateAllDevices 516bc clear it; SetAutoDrive/~EControlToPlayer/~EStartMission set it to 1. PS2 +4 set around SendGameMessages in ControllerRemovedC

fields.name: resyncDevices
fields.comment: high: UpdateAllDevices 51655 tests it and does an extra PollDevice pass, 5168d clears; Initialize 5109a clears; movie players FUN_0005a6b0 and ~ESetVideo set 1 before EnableUpdating(true). Name invented

fields.name: numControllers
fields.comment: high: CreateDevices indexes padDevices/inputActionMappings by [ESI+4] and increments it (ends at 4); ReleaseDevices/UpdateAllDevices loop bound; ReleaseDevices sets 0

fields.name: padDevices
fields.comment: high: CreateDevices 50ff8 MOV [ESI+EAX*4+8],EDI; ReleaseAllButtons [ECX+EAX*4+8]; ReleaseDevices/UpdateAllDevices walk from +8; 16 slots fixed by inputActionMappings at +0x48 (only 0..3 written)

fields.name: inputActionMappings
fields.comment: high: CreateDevices 51034 MOV [ESI+ECX*4+0x48],EAX; ReleaseDevices [ESI+0x40] from +8; UpdateAllDevices passes [EBP] from +0x48 to SendGameMessages; SetConfig/InitAndPreload index by glbIFeedback

fields.name: padStable
fields.comment: medium: CheckUnplugged 50ee9 sets 1 then tests it (always true); GetIOModule zeroes. PS2 CheckUnplugged sets its equivalent from PAD_isstable. Name invented

fields.name: checkUnpluggedCount
fields.comment: high: CheckUnplugged 50ee3 INC dword [ESI+0x8c]; not read on Xbox (PS2 used it for every-4th-call timing). Name invented

fields.name: unpluggedMessageShown
fields.comment: high: CheckUnplugged: set 1 after GHud::SetControllerUnplugged(1) (50f56), 0 after SetControllerUnplugged(0) (50f75); tested before either. Name invented

fields.name: controllerUnplugged
fields.comment: high: CheckUnplugged 50f1b stores !PAD_isconnected(port); Update 516f4 skips UpdateAllDevices when set. Name invented

fields.name: currentTick
fields.comment: high: Update 516e9 stores TIMER_gettick(); SendGameMessages 513e9/5143b reads it for auto-repeat and stores it into scalar extra1. Name invented

fields.name: unused98
fields.comment: medium: Only GetIOModule 515c7 writes 0; no other reference found in the IOModule functions or via the static address

fields.name: repeatDelayTicks
fields.comment: high: Initialize 510bb = TIMER_getfrequency()*300/1000; SendGameMessages 51477 uses it when scalar repeat state ==1. Name invented

fields.name: repeatIntervalTicks
fields.comment: high: Initialize 510df = TIMER_getfrequency()*150/1000; SendGameMessages 513de uses it for repeat state !=1. Name invented

types.comment: Singleton at 0x001e45a0 (GetIOModule 0x51580, guard 0x001e4644 directly after it proves size 0xa4). No vptr; trivial destructor (atexit target 0x15ce00 is RET). PS2 layout differs (+0xc numControllers, 8 ports).

types.name: InputToAction

fields.name: numTables
fields.comment: high: ctor 50891 stores device->GetNumDeviceScalar(); Reset 50990 loop bound; dtor FastFree(+0xc, [+0]*8+8)

fields.name: tables
fields.comment: high: ctor 508d8: new[](n*0x3c+4) with count cookie, eh vector ctor InputTable::InputTable 507a0 stride 0x3c; SendGameMessages/ReleaseAllButtons [mapping+4]+i*0x3c; dtor vector-dtor with [tables-4]

fields.name: scalarNameLookup
fields.comment: high: ctor 50959 FastAlloc(0x10,"StringToNumber") + StringToNumber ctor 119f50 over +0xc; LoadParseDefFile ConvertStringToNumber(+8, scalar name); dtor ~StringToNumber 11a020 + FastFree 0x10. Name invented

fields.name: scalarNames
fields.comment: high: ctor 508e2 FastAlloc(n*8+8,"StringToNumberEntry"); [i]={i, device->scalars[i].name}; [n]={0,0}; dtor FastFree(n*8+8). Name invented

types.comment: Per-device mapping from scalars to actions. ctor 0x50860 (SEH, RET 4), dtor 0x509c0 (non-deleting), Reset 0x50990, LoadParseDefFile 0x50a20. Allocated FastAlloc(0x10,"InputToAction") by CreateDevices, freed FastFree(p,0x10) by ReleaseDevices.

types.name: InputTable

fields.name: count
fields.comment: high: ctor 507a5 = 0; SendGameMessages 512a4 entry loop count; Reset zeroes; LoadParseDefFile increments after append

fields.name: capacity
fields.comment: high: ctor 507ab = 4; GrowArrayForOneElement += 4; dtor FastFree(entries, capacity*0xc); LoadParseDefFile grows when capacity <= count

fields.name: entries
fields.comment: high: ctor 507b2 = this+0xc; SendGameMessages 512f0 MOV ESI,[EDX+8] + j*0xc; dtor frees if != this+0xc

fields.name: inlineEntries
fields.comment: high: ctor points entries at +0xc with capacity 4; 0xc + 4*0xc = 0x3c = element stride

types.comment: One per device scalar; PS2 name. ctor 0x507a0, dtor 0x507c0, GrowArrayForOneElement 0x507e0 (capacity += 4, FastAlloc "TableEntries").

types.name: InputTableEntry

fields.name: updateMethod
fields.comment: high: SendGameMessages 51320 switch on [ESI] 0..9 via jump table 0x51550; compared to 8/9 in the change filter; ReleaseAllButtons compares 2/4; values from StringToNumber table 0x1b6fd0 U + - > < = I N R M

fields.name: threshold
fields.comment: high: SendGameMessages 51389/513b7 push [ESI+4] to isDown/UpTransitionThreshold; LoadParseDefFile defaults 0x3f000000 for kinds 3,4 and sscanf %f

fields.name: action
fields.comment: high: SendGameMessages copies [ESI+8] into ActionData.action; LoadParseDefFile stores getActionID(name)

types.comment: PS2 name (InputTable::AddTableEntry(InputTableEntry &)). Written by LoadParseDefFile as {method, threshold, action}.

types.name: StringToNumberEntry

fields.name: number
fields.comment: high: InputToAction ctor 508f3 MOV [EDX+EAX*8],EAX (index); table 0x1b6fd0 holds 0..9

fields.name: string
fields.comment: high: InputToAction ctor 50900 stores scalar name pointer at [+EAX*8+4]; table 0x1b6fd0 holds pointers to 'U','+',...

types.comment: PS2 name (StringToNumber::StringToNumber(StringToNumberEntry *)). {0,NULL} terminated; same shape as the static tables at 0x1b6fd0 and 0x1b6ba0.
